static.name: Uniform delivered-source inventory v1
static.formatting: As delivered; no reformatting or target execution.
notes: Runtime JSON/YAML/catalog tables are counted separately, never hidden as source reduction.
Source AST excludes docstrings; moving configuration or metadata into resources also reduces AST.
Static counts describe artifacts and are not a semantic, quality, or human-readability score.
This inventory is separate from historical harness size gates; evidence/report additions are excluded.
Read-only static measurement; target repository code was never imported or executed for this comparison.
All7 snapshots were verified against every tracked Git blob. Published heads and tested production commits are distinguished.
No universal pass rate: command groups, individual tests, probes and developer tasks have different denominators.
No single end-to-end runtime or total-cost ranking: accounting boundaries differ.
Unknown usage stays null. Cache and reasoning subsets are not double counted. Raw session transcripts, private paths and prompts are not published.
Current final-state comparison uses Nov3 repair evidence for Graphify/Knowledge, not their regressed Nov2 initial reports.
Observation-based comparison: selected goals, source-access policy, environment, model and stopping criteria differ.
reproduction: Use pinned snapshots in directories original,memory,dual,efficient,effort,knowledge,graphify. Install tiktoken==0.12.0; run python measure_snapshots.py SNAPSHOT_ROOT OUTPUT_DIR. Match the recorded cl100k_base rank digest.
